name: Morpheridine
summary: Is a 4-Phenylpiperidine derivative that is related to pehidine. It is roughly 4x as potent as the parent compound and is reported to not cause convulsions that pethidine reportedly does.

uses.text: Morpheridine (Morpholinoethylnorpethidine) is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is related to the clinically used opioid analgesic drug pethidine (meperidine). Morpheridine is not currently used in medicine and is a Schedule I drug which is controlled under UN drug conventions.

sideEffects.text: It is a strong analgesic with around 4 times the potency of pethidine, and unlike pethidine, does not cause convulsions, although it produces the standard opioid side effects such as sedation and respiratory depression.
